name: Partner clinic in Ginza
access: 5 min walk from Ginza Station (Exit A3) · 5 min from Shimbashi Station
accessNote: There is no entrance on Chuo-dori. Enter from the Hanatsubaki-dori side street, walk through the parking area, and take the elevator at the back.
cancellation:
Free until 3 days before. ¥5,500 from 2 days before until 12:00 the previous day. ¥11,000 from 12:00 to 19:00 the previous day. ¥22,000 on the day, or for no-shows. Free if you cancel within 12 hours of booking. Rescheduling to another date also incurs these fees.

Time change on the day: ¥3,300 for first-time patients (moving your time by an hour or more).
fees: First-visit fee ¥3,630 (when a treatment is performed the same day). ¥11,000 if you book a consultation only, without treatment. Optional fee to request the clinic director (varies by treatment). Some treatments carry a 20% Saturday surcharge.
